s.how: Mix 250g self-raising flour, 2 tbsp sugar, 1 egg, 150ml milk and 30g melted butter into a soft dough. Roll into 24 balls and fry at 175C for 3 minutes. Toss in 100g sugar mixed with 2 tsp cinnamon.
Grill 4 corn cobs until charred, brush with 40g melted butter and sprinkle with chilli and salt. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

m.how: Stretch 500g pizza dough onto a tray, spread with pizza sauce and top with 200g mozzarella and 100g pepperoni. Bake at 240C for 12 minutes.

w.how: Sandwich 1L vanilla ice cream between 16 soft chocolate cookies and freeze 30 minutes. Serve it at the halfway point of the film. Leave it out for anyone who wants seconds.

d.how: Pour cold lemonade over ice in 4 big cups. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold. Keep a second round ready for the back half of the film.
